children.name: Article Eyebrow
children.text: PLATFORM

children.name: Article Title
children.text: Multi-cluster topology and limits

children.name: Article Lead
children.text: Make cluster boundaries explicit and operate independent environments without implying unsupported scheduling or automatic failover.

children.name: Article Callout Text
children.text: Share policy through GitOps and SSO; do not share live databases, controller state, or repository credentials across boundaries.

children.name: Section Title 1
children.text: Define the control boundary

children.name: Section Body 1
children.text: Document the supported relationship between control plane, database, namespace scope, target cluster, and audit history.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 0
children.text: Combined installs share one control plane and database; standalone panels run them without Kubernetes.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 1
children.text: Record cluster identity, resource UIDs, namespace, and ownership.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 2
children.text: Call out unsupported cross-cluster scheduling and automatic failover.

children.name: Section Title 2
children.text: Operate independent environments

children.name: Section Body 2
children.text: Reuse policy safely while isolating credentials, failure domains, backups, endpoints, and live state.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 0
children.text: Run isolated releases, databases, repositories, and credentials.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 1
children.text: Keep redirect URLs and service accounts cluster-specific.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 2
children.text: Use stable cluster labels in alerts, exports, dashboards, and backup paths.

children.name: Section Title 3
children.text: Promote and migrate

children.name: Section Body 3
children.text: Combined installs promote Cluster CRs and modules through GitOps; standalone panels keep registrations in their database. Move worlds only through verified backup and restore.

children.name: Quick Reference Label
children.text: BOUNDARY MODEL

children.name: Quick Reference Line 1
children.text: 01  Control plane + DB + target cluster = operational boundary

children.name: Quick Reference Line 2
children.text: 02  Share GitOps/SSO policy, not live state or credentials

children.name: Quick Reference Line 3
children.text: 03  Move → export config + backup + restore + endpoint/owner validation

children.name: Article Callout Text
children.text: The optional agent gateway and the unified cross-cluster dashboard described below are available since v0.3.0.

children.name: Section Title 1
children.text: Manage independent clusters from one dashboard

children.name: Section Body 1
children.text: One central API and login manages independent clusters, combined or standalone (v0.4.0).

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 0
children.text: Central API uses each cluster's Kubernetes API for resource changes, Pod logs, and PTY attach

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 1
children.text: Dashboard combines resources across clusters with optional Cluster filter (v0.3.0)

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 2
children.text: Requires matching API, operator, and agent versions in all clusters
